[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农吃了以后，他没有病” / Formula: Subject + 吃了 + object + 以后，+ 没有 + verb / Correct: “神农吃了灵芝以后，没有生病。” “没有病” is understandable, but “没有生病” is more natural for saying that he did not become ill. Removing “他” also avoids an unclear reference to either 神农 or the man in blue.
